title: GTA VI Official Screenshots vs Fake Leaks: Verification
summary: Learn to evaluate Rockstar's screenshot gallery, artwork and alleged GTA VI leak images before launch.
intro: GTA VI's marketing has included trailers, launch galleries, character artwork and clips. Rockstar's official media section offers a large selection of screenshots and art, but unofficial social accounts frequently repost these images beside fabricated gameplay claims. This guide helps readers separate genuine media from unsupported captions, especially before the November 19 release.

sections.heading: Start with the publisher's actual media library
paragraphs: Rockstar's GTA VI media hub organizes screenshots, artwork, videos and clips. A genuine image can still be mislabeled after someone reposts it. Check whether the content matches a published gallery and record which announcement introduced it. The existence of a screenshot does not prove that the location is a mission objective or that every pictured interaction is controllable.

sections.heading: Be cautious with edited images
paragraphs: Color grading, cropping, upscaling and added UI graphics can make a screenshot appear like a newly leaked menu. Look for inconsistent typography, unusual shadows or elements that do not match the original framing, but remember that image appearance alone cannot always establish authenticity. An edited image is not necessarily malicious; the problem occurs when an edit is presented as an official gameplay revelation.

sections.heading: Use specific language in coverage
paragraphs: Say that an official screenshot shows a vehicle, skyline or landscape. Do not jump to claims of a driveable model list, exact map dimensions or enterable interiors without separate confirmation. Label interpretations as possibilities, not promises. Avoid writing sensational headlines implying Rockstar announced a feature when the only evidence is a fan theory about a background object.

sections.heading: Respect copyright and attribution internally
paragraphs: Having access to official media does not automatically grant unlimited rights to repackage it as your own proprietary artwork. Review the publisher's media usage guidance when considering a blog illustration. You can create original charts, explainers and observations without downloading a promotional image from an unrelated blog. Never strip a creator's watermark or copy someone else's composite graphic to make it appear unique.

sections.heading: Protect yourself from fake pre-release downloads
paragraphs: Some alleged leaks are bait for malicious installers or credential phishing. GTA VI is currently confirmed for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, not a legitimate public Windows demo. Do not install a file claiming to unlock the full game early based on a screenshot of a launcher. Verify release information directly and wait for supported platform distribution.
